mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 67 degrees.

The city has announced that Hwy M near the future Aldi location will be closed for road work from October 6 to October 9, with traffic redirected to Old PB and Verona Avenue. Additionally, residents can begin early voting for the November 3 election at City Hall starting October 20.
There is plenty to do today, including the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park and music at Paddy Mac's, with Hop Haus trivia following tomorrow.
On September 24, a vehicle and bicyclist collision occurred on Westward Drive involving an 11-year-old, though thankfully no hospital transport was required.
Treat yourself to today's delicious Flavor of the Day, Double Strawberry, and stop by anytime before the store closes at 10 PM.
